3-implement.harnessDefect: typecheck.mjs reported verdict:clean on a tree with 125 real tsc errors, 20+ in its own scope. Its filter is /(d+,d+): error TSd+/ but tsc emits ANSI pretty output even when stdout is a pipe, so the text is "...:145:18 - \e[91merror\e[0m\e[90m TS1005". Zero lines match, so totalErrors=0 and the two recorded baseline errors also vanish - which the tool reports as "shared code changed" rather than as a parse failure. Fix: pass --pretty false (verified: the same regex then matches 125/125). Stage 3 is one of only two gates blocking Stage 4, so this gate can certify a tree that cannot compile.
